assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容设计与机器校验；官方图件发布后必须整体复算并刷新图件与指标。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 叙事导视带涉及的绿地蓝线、文物保护与建设控制条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论（不预设容积率、高度、拆改留数值），仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory protection and control conditions are unknown; this proposal keeps concept-level indications only, with no FAR, height or demolition figures.

assumptions.statement_zh: 口述史与历史影像内容仅作概念性展示设计引用，不替代权威史志；拟用于实际展示的老照片、口述史、历史声音及旧时刻表尚未获得逐项授权，在授权、核验、知情同意与撤回记录到位前只使用占位或公共领域替代物。
assumptions.statement_en: Oral-history and archival content is concept-level display design only; historical material stays placeholder or public-domain substitutes until item-by-item rights clearance.

assumptions.statement_zh: 站牌叙事站、道钉符号步道与信号声音亭设施均为原创概念建议，模块化可逆，可复用为公共空间组件库，不构成建设承诺；节点选址须经规划、文保与主管部门评估后重新落位。
assumptions.statement_en: All node facilities are original reversible conceptual proposals forming a component library, not construction commitments; sites are subject to statutory relocation.

assumptions.statement_zh: 人流密度感知与标识动态调配仅提供匿名聚合与人工复核兜底：不采集身份可识别信息、不进行个体识别式追踪、禁止过度监控；密度感知须明示传感方式、保留周期、访问权限与重识别风险处置预案，设一键停用与公开审计。
assumptions.statement_en: Density sensing and sign dynamic allocation process anonymized aggregates only with human review; sensing method, retention, access rights and re-identification response are disclosed, with one-touch halt and open audit.

assumptions.statement_zh: 京张叙事导览周、口述史采集工作坊与标识设计共创节等均为建议性设计，不代表已确定的政府安排或投资承诺；活动与试点按验收KPI与退出机制管理，年度公示。
assumptions.statement_en: The event system and phasing are design suggestions, not confirmed government or investment commitments; pilots follow acceptance KPIs and exit mechanisms with annual disclosure.

assumptions.statement_zh: 品牌在先权利与使用边界：主名称「章痕·京张叙事导视带」与 Logo（WAYMARK·JZ）在概念阶段未完成商标检索与法律审查，按内部工作代号处理——不对外注册、不商业使用、不作政府背书表示，正式使用前完成检索与在先权利核验。
assumptions.statement_en: Brand prior rights: the primary name and Logo (WAYMARK·JZ) are internal working codenames until trademark search and legal review are completed; no registration, no commercial use, no endorsement impression before clearance.
